reads.note: Mistral OCR: POST /v1/ocr {model: mistral-ocr-latest, document: {type: document_url|image_url, ...}}; Mistral fetches the R2 URL itself, so n8n downloads nothing. reads.note: Mistral OCR: POST /v1/ocr {model: mistral-ocr-latest, document: {type: document_url|image_url, ...}}; Mistral fetches the R2 URL itself, so n8n downloads nothing. DOC OCR1 and IMAGE OCR1 call the same URL in an order the fixture cannot fix, so both get the same reply (the template's PDF and PNG are the same statement)

branches: no IF/Switch; only Document URL → Mistral DOC OCR1 and Image URL → Mistral IMAGE OCR1 are reachable from the trigger; the Drive, upload and chat branches have no trigger
the workflow has no write and no model: any email or request is outside the definition
